proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal on Workplace Non-Discrimination Audit
proposals.proponent: National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an audit analyzing the impacts of the Company's Diversity, Equity & Inclusion policies on civil rights, non-discrimination and returns to merit, with a public report.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors unanimously recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal on Special Shareholder Meeting Improvement
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to amend governing documents so street name shares and non-street name shares have an equal right to call a special shareholder meeting.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors unanimously recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal.
